cohort: 1134 pregnant women with placental abruption and intrauterine fetal death
finding: While bleeding during delivery was significantly greater in women with placental abruption and intrauterine fetal death who underwent cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery, severe complications like maternal death and uterine rupture occurred only in the vaginal delivery group.
mod_finding: Bleeding during delivery was significantly greater in women with placental abruption and intrauterine fetal death who underwent cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery.
